system.description: Your skin hardens, turning grey and furrowed like an ancient oak. Bark is not metal and does not hinder your casting. Sustained. While it holds, you are very flammable: fire damage against you is doubled.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but you gain t3 armour (-d6) without its penalties.
outcomes.success: While you sustain the spell, you gain t2 armour (-d4) and take d6 less damage from Persistent Damage.
outcomes.failure: You gain t1 armour (-d2) until the end of your next turn, and the spell cannot be sustained.
outcomes.ruin: The bark grows inward: you are Slowed on your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
